name: Oni's Hide

card.plain: The Oni's thick hide: the special it's on has armour at its very start, so it takes a hit without flinching.

notes: Armour = absorbs a hit without being interrupted. How many hits is the programmer's reading of 'armour'; open question. Data only, no new animation (A10); visual is a preset reference for clip-matcher. Number from the rules.md modifiers table.
